Step Title: Increase the regularization hyperparameter.

Hint 1: Consider how regularization affects the complexity of a model. Increasing regularization typically simplifies the model, which can lead to higher bias. Think about what changes could be made to counteract this effect.

Hint 2: Reflect on the relationship between model complexity and bias. If the model is too simple due to high regularization, what adjustments could be made to increase complexity and reduce bias?
